tools.description: Request a bulk quote for a product (buyer tool)

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Create a new product listing (seller tool)

tools.name: get_pricing_recommendation
tools.description: Get AI-powered pricing recommendation for inventory (seller tool)

tools.name: get_quote_requests
tools.description: Get pending quote requests for seller's products (seller tool)

tools.name: respond_to_quote
tools.description: Respond to a buyer's quote request (seller tool)

tools.name: bulk_update_listings
tools.description: Bulk update prices or minimum order quantities across up to 200 of the calling seller's product listings. Thin adapter over POST /api/products/bulk-update-price and /bulk-update-moq — same seller-ownership filter and per-product validation. Choose mode='price_set' (value=USD), 'price_percent_increas

tools.name: bulk_mark_shipped
tools.description: Mark up to 200 of the calling seller's orders as shipped, optionally writing a shared tracking number / URL / carrier to every order. Thin adapter over POST /api/seller/orders/bulk-mark-shipped — same per-order ownership filter, idempotent re-runs, auto-detected carrier when only a tracking number i

tools.name: bulk_export_orders
tools.description: Export the calling seller's orders as CSV (Order ID, Product, Buyer, Quantity, Total, Status, Date). Thin adapter over POST /api/seller/orders/bulk-export — orders not owned by the caller are silently skipped. Returns the CSV body as a string plus the suggested filename.

tools.name: seller_inbox_summarise
tools.description: Read-only digest of the calling seller's inbox: pending quote requests, orders at risk of missing their ship-by deadline, and orders with reported issues. Useful for a daily standup or cron-driven agent that decides which bulk action to run next.

tools.name: quick_buy
tools.description: One-step purchase for products with instant checkout enabled (seller opt-in) and orders under bulk threshold. For products without instant checkout or larger orders, use request_quote instead.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "bulk_export_orders" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Export the calling seller's orders as CSV (Order ID, Product, Buyer, Quantity, Total, Status, Date). Thin adapter over POST /api/seller/orders/bulk-export — ord…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: seller_inbox_summarise · Public sink: bulk_update_listings, bulk_mark_shipped, bulk_export_orders · Destructive: seller_inbox_summarise.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: seller_inbox_summarise · Public sink: bulk_update_listings, bulk_mark_shipped, bulk_export_orders · Destructive: seller_inbox_summarise

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
